# Interactive Chemistry

> Interactive Chemistry provides game-based learning simulations for chemistry education, covering organic reactions, bonding, and fundamental concepts through engaging interactive puzzles.

Created by Steve Sogo, Interactive Chemistry offers a comprehensive suite of educational games and simulations designed to make chemistry concepts accessible and engaging for students. The platform emphasizes interactive learning through visual models, reaction simulations, and puzzle-based gameplay across general chemistry, organic chemistry, and biochemistry topics.

## Organic Chemistry Games

- [Ketone Crush Intro Page](https://InteractiveChemistry.org/IntroPageKetoneCrush): Ketone Crush game: match chemical structures to organic chemistry families
- [SN2 Reaction Game](https://InteractiveChemistry.org/SN2): SN2 Reaction Game: fire nucleophiles at electrophiles to learn substitution
- [SN1 Reaction Game](https://InteractiveChemistry.org/SN1): SN1 Reaction Game: two-step nucleophilic substitution with energy profiles

## Bonding & Molecular Structure

- [Covalent Bonding Game with 21st Century Lewis Dots](https://interactivechemistry.org/2-DMolecularModels): Covalent Bonding Game: build molecules using puzzle pieces and Lewis dot models
- [Matchmaker & PT Intro Page](https://interactivechemistry.org/Matchmaker): Matchmaker Game: learn ionic bonding and periodic table relationships interactively
- [Coulomb's Law Game](https://InteractiveChemistry.org/ElectrostaticForcesIntroPage): Coulomb's Law Game: explore electrostatic forces through six interactive puzzles

## Ionic & Redox Reactions

- [Double Replacement Reactions using Matchmaker Models](https://interactivechemistry.org/MatchmakerReactions): Double Replacement Reactions: model ionic reactions and equation balancing
- [Double Replacement Reaction Simulator](https://interactivechemistry.org/IonicReactions): Ionic Reactions Simulator: react compounds to observe precipitate formation
- [IonicReactions](https://interactivechemistry.org/IonicReactions2020): Ionic Reactions Simulator: demonstrate solubility and limiting reactants concepts
- [Matchmaker with Electron Transfer](https://interactivechemistry.org/CuSO4): Copper Sulfate Redox Game: explore electron transfer reactions with metals
- [Reactions of Calcium Metal](https://interactivechemistry.org/CalciumReactions): Calcium Reactions Game: illustrate redox reactions with water and acids

## General Chemistry Concepts

- [Dimensional Analysis Game](https://InteractiveChemistry.org/DimensionalAnalysis): Dimensional Analysis Game: learn unit conversion through playful chemistry games
- [Combustion Reactions](https://interactivechemistry.org/CombustionReactions): Combustion Reactions Game: simulate fuel reactions and energy conservation concepts
- [Sucrose Hydrolysis with Catalyst](https://interactivechemistry.org/Catalysis): Catalysis Game: model sucrose hydrolysis with acid and enzyme catalysts

## Biochemistry & Life Processes

- [Photosynthesis](https://interactivechemistry.org/Photosynthesis2022): Photosynthesis Game: investigate solar energy conversion to sugar and oxygen

## Home
